{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for implausible values in customer_age
# Age of -1 is likely a sentinel or error value
print("Rows with customer_age == -1:")
print(df[df['customer_age'] == -1])

# Drop rows with invalid age (if any) to avoid bias
# But note: we must check if this affects the 'converted' group
invalid_age_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
if invalid_age_mask.any():
    print(f"Found {invalid_age_mask.sum()} rows with invalid age (-1).")
    # Remove these rows from analysis
    df_clean = df[~invalid_age_mask]
else:
    df_clean = df

# Now compute mean age for those who converted
converted_mean_age = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Output result
converted_mean_age"}
